description: National Fellowship for Scheduled Tribe (NFST) Students - M.Phil/PhD

rules.failure_reason: Student must belong to a Scheduled Tribe.
Student must have qualified NET/JRF conducted by UGC-NTA.
NFST is for M.Phil and PhD scholars only.
Student must be registered in a recognized university/institution.
Student must not hold another active MoTA scholarship.

jrf.description: Junior Research Fellowship for initial 2 years

srf.description: Senior Research Fellowship for remaining tenure

amounts.escort_reader_allowance: for PwD candidates as per norms
